Ocypus Gamma C50 White (650W Bundle) Specifications

Case Specifications

  • Model: Ocypus Gamma C50 White

  • Form Factor: Mid-Tower

  • Color: White

  • Dimensions: Approximately 385mm x 210mm x 450mm

  • Motherboard Support: ATX, Micro-ATX, Mini-ITX

  • I/O Panel:

    • 1 x USB 3.0

    • 2 x USB 2.0

    • HD Audio (Mic/Headphone)

    • Power/Reset Buttons

  • Cooling Support:

    • Front: 3 x 120mm or 2 x 140mm fans (Supports up to 360mm radiator)

    • Top: 2 x 120mm or 2 x 140mm fans (Supports up to 240mm/280mm radiator)

    • Rear: 1 x 120mm fan (Supports 120mm radiator)

  • Clearance:

    • Max GPU Length: Up to 330mm

    • Max CPU Cooler Height: Up to 160mm

  • Drive Bays:
